text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable!? Mejiro Ryan dashes forward furiously!
She defeats star Umamusume Oguri Cap!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*...
What is... the meaning of this...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! Thank you very much!
But...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I don't really remember... I was just
scared, and ran with reckless abandon.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Even so, my body still moved for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... Even when you're not conscious of it, your body still remembers, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I can hardly believe I beat Oguri-san.
Still, I'm very happy...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: O-Oguri-san...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I underestimated you.
I thought this year was still too early for you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
However, that turned out not to be the case.
...That was a good run.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Until we meet again. Next year, at this very place.
I, too... will return in even better shape than this year.

Oguri Cap raised a hand in farewell
and made a brisk exit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So cool...
So that's... a star Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah, are you free at the end of next year?
Will your schedule be all right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I-I'm fine...
You didn't have to go out of your way to come back..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Racing against a superstar! It was a fantastic experience to prepare for next year!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Next... the GⅠ race after the new year is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I want to go to the Spring Tenno Sho! I want to take this experience and throw it all at McQueen! Please!

Having scored an upset victory over Oguri Cap,
Mejiro Ryan now fixes her gaze on the next target.

—The Tenno Sho (Spring). A rematch with
Mejiro McQueen is bound to be a fiercer battle than ever.
